decisions.why: 10 of the 11 sub-categories (Sink Wash, Powders, Toilet Cleaners, Washroom Cleaners, Sanitisers, Degreaser, Ovens, Dishwasher Detergents, Odour Neutraliser, Hard Floor Cleaner, Glass) are cleaning chemicals; the one equipment sub-category (Dosing and Dispensing Equipment) is the dispensing hardware sold alongside those same chemicals, not a separate general equipment range
